cards.card_text: Then God names the ten peoples whose land it is, from the Kenites to the Jebusites, and yes, the Amorites are on the list.
cards.verse_text: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
cards.snippet: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”

cards.card_text: Next he sees the Kenites, the people of Moses' father-in-law (Judges 1:16).
cards.verse_text: Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Your dwelling place is secure, and your nest is set in a cliff.
cards.snippet: Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Your dwelling place is secure, and…

cards.card_text: Now Heber the Kenite, from the family of Moses' father-in-law Hobab, has pitched his tent near Kedesh, so tuck that name in your apron pocket.
cards.verse_text: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim, which was near Kedesh.
cards.snippet: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law…

cards.card_text: Sisera runs on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite.
cards.verse_text: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
cards.snippet: …on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house…

cards.card_text: Then he warns the Kenites, a people living near the Amalekites, to get away from them.
cards.verse_text: And he warned the Kenites, “Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt, go on and get away from the Amalekites.
cards.snippet: And he warned the Kenites, “Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up…

cards.card_text: Saul warns the Kenites so they don't get swept away with the Amalekites.

cards.card_text: True or false: The Kenites ignore Saul's warning and stay near the Amalekites.

cards.card_text: Then he goes back to Achish, who asks him, "What have you raided today?" And David answers, "The Negev of Judah," or "The Negev of Jerahmeel," or "The Negev of the Kenites."
cards.verse_text: Then he would return to Achish, who would ask him, “What have you raided today?” And David would reply, “The Negev of Judah,” or “The Negev of Jerahmeel,” or “The Negev of the Kenites.”
